title: ECL-1 implementers registry
description: The implementers registry of ECL-1 (community/implementers.yaml): self-declared conformance claims, each with a link to its conformance report. The procedure in governance/CONFORMANCE_CLAIMS.md defines what the editors check before they list a claim. A listing certifies nothing.

name.description: The implementation's name, with its version.

organization.description: The organization, or the person, that makes the claim.

claim.description: The claim's public statement, with every element that Section 7.7 of the standard requires (ECL1N-0078).

status.description: The listing's status. Every claim in the registry is self-declared; the claim status of Section 7.6 is part of the claim's statement.

listed.description: The date on which the editors listed the claim.

report.description: The conformance report: the conformance tests' results and the offline verifier's output on the implementation's evidence.

assessment.description: An assessor's assessment of the claim, listed separately when the implementer provides it.
